definitions.gloss: power strip; extension outlet; power bar
definitions.explanation: A device with multiple electrical outlets that connects to a single power source, allowing multiple devices to be powered from one socket.

examples.japanese: {電源|でんげん}タップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧、⟦コンセント→コンセント：04431_konsento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やした→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: I bought a power strip to add more outlets.

examples.japanese: 6⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電源|でんげん}タップ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A 6-outlet power strip should be enough.
examples.notes: {口|くち} is the counter for outlets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雷|かみなり}サージ→雷サージ：noentry⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電源|でんげん}タップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a power strip with surge protection.

notes:
{電源|でんげん}タップ is a power strip: one plug into the wall, several sockets out. The name is ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧ (power source) + タップ. It is also sold as ⟦テーブルタップ→テーブルタップ：noentry⟧, or just ⟦タップ→タップ：noentry⟧ in conversation.

COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電源|でんげん}タップ (a power strip with ~ sockets — the standard way to state the size)
- ⟦{雷|かみなり}サージ→雷サージ：noentry⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (surge-protected, a common selling point)
- ⟦スイッチ→スイッチ：03848_suicchi⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (with individual switches)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コンセント→コンセント：04431_konsento⟧ - the wall socket itself (from English 'concentric plug', not 'consent')
- ⟦{延長|えんちょう}コード→延長コード：07087_enchoukoodo⟧ - an extension cord, which adds length rather than sockets
